consent.title: Cookies
consent.description: To improve the site experience, I use PostHog, Microsoft Clarity and Vercel Analytics (anonymized data). No tracking without your consent. Thank you!

playerProfile.helpBody: A nickname or Google account gives you one identity across games. On this device, your progress and scores are linked to it automatically.

tools.title: Tools
tools.mergeDescription: Combine PDF files into one document, in your preferred order.
tools.privacy: Your files stay on your device. No documents are sent to a server.
tools.drop: Drop your PDFs here or choose files.
tools.needTwo: Add at least two PDFs to merge them.
tools.success: Your PDF is ready. The download has started.
tools.invalid: This file is not a valid PDF.
tools.encrypted: This PDF is encrypted. Add an unprotected version.
tools.failed: Merging failed. Try again or remove the affected documents.
tools.readFailed: Unable to read this file. Try adding it again.

colorGenerator.title: Color palette generator
colorGenerator.intro: Create harmonious shades and export your colors for design and development.
colorGenerator.invalidHex: Enter a valid 3- or 6-character HEX code.
colorGenerator.name: Palette name
colorGenerator.copyError: Copy failed. Select and copy the content manually.

imageCompressor.title: Compress images
imageCompressor.drop: Drop JPG, PNG or WEBP images here, or select them.
imageCompressor.privacy: 100% local — Your images never leave your device
imageCompressor.invalidSettings: Enter a positive size and a dimension of at least 1 pixel.
imageCompressor.settingsHint: Settings apply to all selected images. Each compression starts from the originals. The target size depends on the format and image.
imageCompressor.error: Compression failed. Check the image and try again.
imageCompressor.zipError: Could not create the ZIP archive. Try again or download the images individually.
imageCompressor.intro: Reduce the file size of JPG, PNG and WEBP images directly in your browser.

imageConverter.title: Image converter
imageConverter.intro: Convert images to WEBP, PNG or JPEG directly in your browser.
imageConverter.privacy: 100% local — Your images never leave your device
imageConverter.drop: Drop images here or select files
imageConverter.formats: PNG, JPG, WEBP, SVG, HEIC and HEIF
imageConverter.zipFailed: Could not create the ZIP. You can download each image separately.
imageConverter.hint: Images are processed one at a time. JPEG uses a white background for transparent areas. Metadata is discarded; only the main HEIC image is converted.
imageConverter.limits: Maximum: 100 MB per file, 64 million pixels and 16,384 pixels per side. SVGs must be self-contained, without external styles or resources.
imageConverter.externalSvg: This SVG contains external styles or resources. Use a self-contained SVG.
imageConverter.tooLarge: This image exceeds the browser’s size limits.
imageConverter.encodeFailed: The browser could not produce this format. Try another format.

qrGenerator.title: QR Code generator
qrGenerator.intro: Create a custom QR Code, add your logo and export it as PNG or SVG, directly in your browser.
qrGenerator.privacy: 100% local — your content and logo stay on your device.
qrGenerator.forcedLevel: Error correction H is enabled automatically with a logo.
qrGenerator.scanHint: Keep a strong contrast and test scanning before sharing your QR Code. A margin of 4 modules is recommended.
qrGenerator.logoHint: PNG, JPEG or WEBP • Maximum 10 MB. Dimensions are limited to 25% of the QR Code.
qrGenerator.empty: Enter text or a URL to display your QR Code.
qrGenerator.tooLong: This content is too long for a QR Code. Shorten it or remove the logo to reduce error correction.
qrGenerator.copied: SVG code copied to the clipboard.
qrGenerator.copyError: Could not copy the SVG. Allow clipboard access or download the SVG file.
qrGenerator.exportError: Could not export the QR Code. Try again or remove the logo.
qrGenerator.logoError: Choose a valid PNG, JPEG or WEBP image no larger than 10 MB.

backoffice.title: Backoffice
backoffice.emptyText: This space shows, live, what you do on the site: how far your mouse has travelled, your clicks, the games you've played… and how you compare to other visitors.
backoffice.emptyPrivacy: To see it, please accept analytics cookies. Nothing can identify you: every session is anonymous.
backoffice.comparison: Your mouse has travelled {ratio}× the average
